🏴 OFFICIAL COP & BLACK FLAG TELEMETRY — START 04:15 WIB

Full Marathon (42.195K) — Cut-Off Points (COP 1–3) & Black Flag Medal Calculation

The Bank Jateng Borobudur Marathon 2026 (42.195K Full Marathon) started at 04:15 WIB (Waves: W1 04:15, W2 04:20, W3 04:25, W4 04:30 WIB) using the same official race clock for every wave. Official Cut-Off Points are COP 1 at KM 10 (closes 06:05 WIB), COP 2 at KM 20 (closes 07:35 WIB), COP 3 at KM 34.5 (closes 09:50 WIB), and FINISH at KM 42.195 (closes 11:00 WIB). Due to high temperature/WBGT, the race was halted by the Black Flag at 09:45 WIB. Runners who passed COP 3 (KM 34 / KM 35 / KM 39.4 within 09:50 WIB) but did not finish due to the halt are classified as Finished Black Flag (2,346 runners — get finisher medals 🏅), bringing total recognized Marathon finishers to 4,255 of 4,857 (87.61%). Runners who did not pass COP 1, COP 2, or COP 3 (including 76 stopped at KM 28.4–31.2 before COP 3 and 63 cut off at KM 19.6 / COP 2) are classified as DNF (188 runners).
